title: Deep Learning Classification of Canine Behavior Using a Single Collar-Mounted Accelerometer: Real-World Validation.
summary: Primary MDPI article plus linked bioRxiv v1 (2020-12-14) confirm deep-learning collar accelerometer behavior classification and real-world owner validation; v1 abstract reports >5,000 videos/2,500 dogs, >11 million device-days, 10,550 dogs/163,110 event responses, eating/drinking sensitivity/specificity and production true-positive rates. Full v1 HTML was accessed; core result-bearing claims agree with journal article. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Learned behavior classifier received real-world user validation at scale; labels are owner reports and validation covers mainly eating/drinking, not every behavior.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
